description: The config parser trims keys but not values, so three typed accessors read the padded value and mis-parse it.
prompt: Three tests in config/test_settings.py are failing. Work out why and fix the repository so that the whole suite passes. Do not change the tests.
notes: One root cause: parse_config strips the key but stores the value as partition left it, so every value written as 'key = value' keeps the space after the separator. The three failing tests are three faces of that: get_bool sees ' true' and does not recognise it, get_int sees ' 8080' whose isdigit() is False and raises, and endpoint builds ' example.com:...'. The fix is one call, value.strip(), in config/parser.py. A symptom-by-symptom fix is available and wrong: an agent can trim the value inside get_bool, inside get_int and inside endpoint, or loosen get_int to int(value) because int() tolerates whitespace, and turn the three visible tests green while the parser still returns padded values. The withheld tests compare parse_config's mapping directly and exercise get_list, a fourth accessor nobody patched, so that route fails; config/settings.py is also outside allowedPaths, so editing it counts as an unnecessary change. One withheld test keeps a value with two spaces inside it, so a fix that removes all whitespace rather than trimming the ends fails too.
